resource.description: ScalpStream US equity options screener: short-dated (0-30 DTE) options candidates ranked by composite score, with ATR%, relative volume, RSI, VWAP distance and implied volatility (impersonal research publication). Requires request header X-Compliance-Attestation: not-sanctioned-party

bazaar.description: US equity options screener: short-dated candidates ranked by a composite score, each with the observed metrics behind the ranking — ATR%, relative volume, RSI, VWAP distance, 30-minute momentum, at-the-money implied volatility, daily trend and session phase — plus an illustrative contract with delta, bid/ask spread, volume and open interest. Which names are showing setups right now, scored and ranked. Impersonal research data — no plan, sizing, or verdict.

example.operator_position_disclosure: The operator actively trades securities named in this feed and may transact (including before, after, or contrary to any signal shown) at any time and without notice. Assume the operator holds a position in any name shown.
example.disclaimer: This is an impersonal, general-circulation research feed for educational and informational purposes only. It is the same for every recipient and is not tailored to anyone's financial situation. It is NOT investment advice and NOT a recommendation to buy or sell any security or option. Options trading involves substantial risk of loss. Do your own research and consult a licensed professional before trading.

withheld_pending_payment: every remaining ranked candidate (the free sample names one)
the composite score and letter grade behind each ranking
observed metrics per candidate: ATR%, relative volume, RSI, VWAP distance, 30-minute momentum, at-the-money implied volatility, day change
daily trend, momentum direction, event risk and session phase
an illustrative contract per candidate: expiry, DTE, delta, bid/ask, spread %, volume and open interest
how many confluences and how many cautions each candidate carries
macro factor, news-sentiment score, and the headlines the scanner read
sample.not_included_even_when_paid: No trade plan at any price. The paid response carries no entry, stop, target, direction, risk/reward or position size — they are removed before publication so the feed remains impersonal, general-circulation research data rather than advice. Any contract shown is illustrative of the setup, not an instruction to trade it.

example.note: Pay via x402 (HTTP 402) to receive the full ranked feed.
